metadata.question: Does the valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decrease from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: The user wants to know if valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decreased from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has good temporal resolution and cloud detection 2. Focus on October 22, 2018 3. Define Upper Arrow Lake area (British Columbia, Canada) 4. Compare morning vs afternoon fog/cloud coverage 5. Use cloud masking to identify fog/cloud coverage 6. Calculate percentage of cloudy pixels in each time period 7. Compare morning vs afternoon percentages For fog detection, I'll use the QA60 band in Sentinel-2 which has cloud detection flags. Valley fog typically appears as low clouds, so the cloud mask should capture it. Time periods: - Morning: ~10:00 local time (17:00 UTC) - Afternoon: ~14:00 local time (21:00 UTC) I need to check for: - Empty collections (C1) - No valid pixels after masking (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const upperArrowLake = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2, 50.5]).buffer(5000); const date = '2018-10-22'; // Morning (10:00-12:00 local time) - approx 17:00-19:00 UTC const morningStart = ee.Date(date).advance(17, 'hour'); const morningEnd = ee.Date(date).advance(19, 'hour'); // Afternoon (14:00-16:00 local time) - approx 21:00-23:00 UTC const afternoonStart = ee.Date(date).advance(21, 'hour'); const afternoonEnd = ee.Date(date).advance(23, 'hour'); // 2. Data Acquisition function getSentinel2Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(upperArrowLake) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } const morningCol = getSentinel2Collection(morningStart, morningEnd); const afternoonCol = getSentinel2Collection(afternoonStart, afternoonEnd); // Check for empty collections const morningSize = morningCol.size().getInfo(); const afternoonSize = afternoonCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Morning images: ${morningSize}, Afternoon images: ${afternoonSize}`); if (morningSize === 0 || afternoonSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Cloud/fog detection using QA60 band function calculateCloudCoverage(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); // Bit 10: Opaque clouds, Bit 11: Cirrus clouds const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).gt(0) .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).gt(0)); const stats = clouds.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.frequencyHistogram(), geometry: upperArrowLake, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; } // Get first image from each collection const morningImg = morningCol.first(); const afternoonImg = afternoonCol.first(); const morningStats = calculateCloudCoverage(morningImg).getInfo(); const afternoonStats = calculateCloudCoverage(afternoonImg).getInfo(); // 4. Extract cloud percentages function getCloudPercentage(stats) { if (!stats || !stats['QA60']) return null; const hist = stats['QA60']; const total = (hist['0'] || 0) + (hist['1'] || 0); if (total === 0) return null; const cloudPixels = hist['1'] || 0; return (cloudPixels / total) * 100; } const morningCloud = getCloudPercentage(morningStats); const afternoonCloud = getCloudPercentage(afternoonStats); console.log(`Morning cloud %: ${morningCloud?.toFixed(1) || 'N/A'}`); console.log(`Afternoon cloud %: ${afternoonCloud?.toFixed(1) || 'N/A'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (morningCloud === null || afternoonCloud === null) { console.log("C2"); } else if (isNaN(morningCloud) || isNaN(afternoonCloud)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (afternoonCloud < morningCloud) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
